$comment: Vendored brand assets. hauska-map OWNS these files; this repo is a CONSUMER and
never edits them. P-239 exists because the masthead mark was redrawn by hand from a
redrawing, with nobody comparing either against the canonical file.
The lock that makes drift LOUD instead of silent is brand-provenance.test.ts: it
re-hashes each vendored file on disk against sha256 below, and compares the SVG text
inlined in smart-site-brand.ts byte-for-byte against the file. Editing any one of the
three without the other two fails the suite.
Refresh procedure: re-copy from the source repo at a NEW commit, update commit +
sha256 here, re-run the suite, and state the geometry delta in the PR.
`.gitattributes` pins these paths to eol=lf. Without it core.autocrlf=true rewrites
them on checkout and the sha256 lock fails on every Windows clone -- a guardrail that
does not survive a clone is not a guardrail.

note: The brand package has a v2 (docs/smart-site-brand/v2/), but v2 is a TOKEN and
COMPONENT system -- it does not redefine the mark. Verified two ways: the v2 commit
adds no file under logo/, and the two logo blob shas are identical before and after
it (5c121bb / 22e27be at both HEAD and origin/main). v2/README.md restates the same
mark ruling, 'Gold #E8963B is the brand mark and nothing else'. These two files are
therefore CURRENT canon under v2, not a superseded v1 asset.

paperSubstitutions.reason: Canon targets a dark ground. #ffffff measures 1.034:1 on --ss-paper #FCFBF9 -- not low-contrast, invisible. The substitution is forced.

#F5B95C measures 1.695:1 on paper and fails even the 3:1 large-text floor. --ss-print-gold #B87116 measures 3.752:1, which passes WCAG AA for LARGE text; the wordmark renders at ~17.9pt bold, above the 14pt-bold threshold. NOTE: 3.752 is BELOW the 4.5:1 normal-text floor, so this colour is valid for the wordmark ONLY. report-chrome-tokens.ts recorded this as '4.6:1'; that figure was wrong and is corrected in the same change.
UNCHANGED from canon. A filled graphic element, not text, so the text contrast floors do not apply; the existing frame ruling keeps true --ss-gold for the dot alone.

geometryChanges: NONE. Every stroke weight, radius, tick extent and coordinate is read from the vendored SVG at module load. No hand-entered geometry constant remains in report-chrome.ts to drift.
